Resolves #20344

Related: #20328

Post-merge validation of #20346 caught a YAML comment-truncation bug on `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml:28`: in an unquoted YAML scalar, ` #{0}` inside `format('PR #{0} mergeability', github.event.pull_request.number)` is parsed as a trailing YAML comment (because `#` is preceded by a space), truncating `jobs.publish.name` at `'PR` and causing GitHub Actions' workflow expression evaluator to fail in `0s` on `dev`. Wrapping `jobs.publish.name` in double quotes preserves the full `${{ ... }}` expression string, and `ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` now locks `job.name` directly.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite `ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` asserting parsed `job.name` + `check-workflow-concurrency.mjs`) → L2 required (workflow YAML scalar and unit spec assertion).

| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` (`expect(job.name).toBe("${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && format('PR #{0} mergeability', github.event.pull_request.number) || 'Publish open dev PR mergeability' }}")`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` (`expect(step.with.retries).toBe(3)`) |
| AC-3 | `node node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` (`10 cancelling block(s) of 14 across 25 workflow file(s), all rerun-safe.`) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` (`8 passed (449ms)` under `npm run test-unit`) |
